quests.title: The Lost Pendants
quests.offerDialogue: Oh dear… I seem to have misplaced my three pendant stones somewhere in town. They are precious to me. Have you seen them?
quests.activeDialogue: I had the pendants near the pond, the market square, and the east fields. Any luck finding them?
quests.completeDialogue: All three! Bless you, dear traveller. You have a very kind heart.

quests.title: The Merchant's Ingredient
quests.offerDialogue: I'm after a Moonleaf Herb for a special tincture. They grow in sheltered spots near the scholars' quarter. Fetch me one and I'll make it worth your while.
quests.activeDialogue: Moonleaf Herb — look for it growing in the shade near the scholars' hall.
quests.completeDialogue: Perfect condition! Here, take this as thanks. A rare find, just like yourself.

collectible.name: Moonleaf Herb
collectible.desc: A rare herb prized by alchemists. Vex seems pleased.

quests.title: The Scholar's Anthology
quests.offerDialogue: I'm trying to reassemble a three-volume anthology that was scattered across town ages ago. The first tome ended up in the card emporium, if I'm not mistaken…

activeDialogue.tome-1: The first tome is in the card emporium. Look on the shelves.
activeDialogue.tome-2: Excellent! The second volume was sold to a trader. Check the trading post.
activeDialogue.tome-3: Almost there! The final volume ended up near the fishing pond, I believe.

quests.completeDialogue: The trilogy is complete! This is extraordinary scholarship. Please, take this codex as thanks.

collectible.name: Scholar's Codex
collectible.desc: A rare three-volume anthology compiled by Archivist Naia.

quests.title: The Innkeeper's Package
quests.offerDialogue: Oh, would you be a dear? I have a package for Captain Thorin in the north barracks. I simply cannot leave the inn right now!
quests.activeDialogue: Please take the package to Guard Captain Thorin in the north barracks.
quests.completeDialogue: Ah, from Rosie! My thanks, traveller. Here — you might find this key useful for the south wing.

collectible.name: Barracks Key
collectible.desc: An old iron key. Fits the south barracks vault.

quests.title: Bait for Greyfish
quests.offerDialogue: Blast — I've gone and dropped my bait jars again. Three of them, scattered somewhere near the pond. These old hands aren't what they were.
quests.activeDialogue: The jars can't have gone far — look around the water's edge and the reeds.
quests.completeDialogue: Ha! Every last one. You've got sharp eyes, wanderer. A lucky charm from me — fish tend to bite better when you've got one.

quests.title: A Delivery for the Trader
quests.offerDialogue: Got a crate of supplies that needs to reach the trader den — can't leave the counter unattended. Take it over, would you?
quests.activeDialogue: The Junk Trader is in the den to the south-west. Don't let him talk you into a swap.
quests.completeDialogue: About time! These are exactly what I needed. Tell Bramble we're square.

quests.title: The Missing Card
quests.offerDialogue: A customer left without paying for a card — then I realised he'd also walked off with one of my rarest pieces! I think he left it at the scholars' hall.
quests.activeDialogue: Check the scholars' hall — someone fitting that description was seen heading that way.
quests.completeDialogue: My Thornlord foil! I thought I'd never see it again. Here, take something in return — consider it a finder's fee.

collectible.name: Foil Thornlord
collectible.desc: A rare foil print of the Thornlord card. Gildwyn was very relieved to have it back.

quests.title: A Runaway Crystal
quests.offerDialogue: One of my enchantment crystals rolled out of the shop during the last tremor. It glows faintly — you should spot it near the market. Please, before someone stands on it.
quests.activeDialogue: It's a small blue crystal — it should be glowing softly somewhere near the market lane.
quests.completeDialogue: Oh, thank goodness. These crystals are attuned to me personally — losing one is like losing a piece of myself. You have my gratitude.

quests.title: A Lost Keepsake
quests.offerDialogue: I apologise for the bother, Commander, but I seem to have dropped a small locket while crossing the courtyard this morning. It belonged to the Commander's family.
quests.activeDialogue: I believe I dropped it somewhere near the well in the courtyard. It is a small silver locket.
quests.completeDialogue: Ah, there it is. My sincerest thanks — this is irreplaceable. I shall keep it safer from now on.

innRumours.text: The south barracks wing has been sealed for years. Captain Thorin keeps to himself about it…
The Elder was pacing the courtyard today, muttering about lost things.
Vex keeps badgering every traveller about rare herbs. If you find some, he pays well.
That archivist Naia never leaves the scholars' hall. Something about old books she cannot find.
Old Greyfish says the pond shimmers at night. Strange glimmers beneath the water, he says…

elder.2: Ah, I remember you. You found my pendants. Come and sit a moment.
elder.4: You have become part of this town's story now, traveller. Few earn that.

innkeeper-rosie.2: Always good to see a friendly face! About that favour I mentioned…
innkeeper-rosie.3: Your room is free of charge, of course. It is the least I can do.

naia-interior.3: Ah, my favourite bibliophile! I have been cataloguing your finds. Quite remarkable.

merchant.2: For you, I will cut a special deal. You have good taste in rare ingredients.

guard-captain-thorin.2: I do not forget those who help me. You have my respect, traveller.
